detail.longDescription: Security Tip: Don't run your containers as root. 🛡️ By default, containers run with root privileges, which increases the risk of a container escape. If an attacker gains control, they have a direct path to the host system. Use the USER instruction in your Dockerfile to switch to a non-privileged user. It's a simple step that drastically reduces your attack surface. Find more vulnerability insights at https:// cvedatabase.com # CyberSecurity # InfoSec # AppSec # Docker
